claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars air live on ABC on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT.
The official streaming home for the 2026 Oscars is Hulu.
Live access to the 2026 Oscars is available through Hulu + Live TV, FuboTV, YouTube TV, and Directv.
Red carpet coverage for the 2026 Oscars begins at 6:30 p.m. ET on ABC and Hulu.
Hulu (Live TV plan) is the main streamer for the 2026 Oscars.
FuboTV, YouTube TV, and Directv carry ABC.
New subscribers can utilize free trials from Hulu + Live TV, Fubo, and DirecTV.
The ABC app or ABC.com requires a cable provider login.
